target.architecture: Cloudflare Clef-Flash joint-schema decision head on Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B

execution_contract.runtime: Google Colab Python CLI on WSL Ubuntu-24.04
execution_contract.auth_strategy: existing ADC; no credential values recorded
execution_contract.inference_path: snapshot_download pinned to release_revision; import joint_schema_model from that snapshot; load_release_model(path, device='cuda'); invoke systemone(model, processor, request)

metric_plan.model_load_seconds: Wall time for load_release_model after the pinned snapshot is downloaded.
metric_plan.case_elapsed_seconds: Wall time for one systemone call, including encode_record and the model forward pass.
metric_plan.input_tokens: The input_tokens field returned by systemone.
metric_plan.cuda_peak_allocated_bytes_per_case: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated after resetting peak stats immediately before the case.
metric_plan.cuda_peak_reserved_bytes_per_case: torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved after resetting peak stats immediately before the case.
metric_plan.gpu_name_and_total_memory: torch.cuda device name and total memory; corroborate with nvidia-smi.
metric_plan.answer_match: Compare the returned typed answer with the fixed expected label/threshold below.

cases.pass_criteria: status.choice equals 'overdue' and large.noul is strictly greater than 0.5.

image.preprocessing: Pillow 11.3.0: decode the fixed source JPEG, convert to RGB, then resize the longest side to 1024 pixels using Image.Resampling.LANCZOS while preserving aspect ratio; pass the resulting RGB pixel array directly to the model.

hand_holding_candy.instructions: Is a human hand visibly holding several pieces of candy?
